votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the Green Street Alley Vacation ordinance.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on vacating a City-owned paper alley in the Marion Park Subdivision between 1300 South and Harrison Avenue and Green Street and 700 East, deferring any adoption to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the rezone and master plan amendment at 16 South 800 West.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on rezoning the property at approximately 16 South 800 West from TSA-UN-T to TSA-UN-C and amending the North Temple Boulevard Plan, deferring adoption to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 57 of 2022, approving Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2022-23.
votes.description: The Council adopted the second budget amendment for FY2022-23, which includes funding for a 16-gate expansion of Concourse B at Salt Lake City International Airport, utility expansion designs at Tooele Valley Airport, and market-based salary adjustments for non-represented airport employees.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 58 of 2022, amending the Fiscal Year 2023 final budget only for Item A-2: Deeply Affordable Housing to Address Immediate and Long-term Homeless Needs ($6 million from CIP Holding Account to General Fund) and creation of Homelessness Housing Grant Fund.
votes.description: The Council partially adopted Budget Amendment No. 3 for FY2022-23, approving $6 million for deeply affordable housing to address immediate and long-term homeless needs, while deferring other items to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 59 of 2022, amending the implementation plan for Growing SLC: A Five Year Housing Plan 2018-2022.
votes.description: The Council adopted an amendment to the Growing SLC housing plan implementation plan to bring the City into compliance with State Code requirements by October 1, 2022.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on The Other Side Village public benefits analysis and below-market lease rate and term and rezoning application, and defer action to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: The Council continued the combined public hearing on the below-market ground lease and rezoning for The Other Side Village pilot project at 1850 West Indiana Avenue, deferring final action to allow more public input.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 60 of 2022, amending the zoning map for a parcel at 1330 South 700 West to rezone from R-1/7,000 (Single-Family Residential District) to CB (Community Business).
votes.description: The Council rezoned the property at 1330 South 700 West from single-family residential to community business in anticipation of future neighborhood-scale mixed-use development.

votes.motion: Approve the appointment of Mark Stephens as the Salt Lake City Engineer.
votes.description: The Council confirmed the mayoral appointment of Mark Stephens to serve as Salt Lake City Engineer.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 61 of 2022, approving a $50,000 loan for Kahve Cafe, LLC from the Economic Development Loan Fund.
votes.description: The Council approved a $50,000 Economic Development Revolving Loan Fund loan to Kahve Café to assist in creating five new jobs and retaining five current jobs within the next year.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 28 of 2022, approving the satisfaction of conditions on $125,000 in the Department of Sustainability's budget for a Community Food Assessment, with accompanying legislative intents.
votes.description: The Council released a budget contingency allowing the Department of Sustainability to use $125,000 to conduct a Community Food Assessment, with legislative intents directing collaboration with other food security entities and future reporting to the Council.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda, including setting the public hearing date for the Ballpark Station Area Plan, approving the appointment of Terressa Clark to the Housing Advisory and Appeals Board, and approving the reappointment of Heidi Steed to the Community Development and Capital Improvement Programs Advisory Board.
votes.description: The Council approved routine consent items including setting a public hearing date for the Ballpark Station Area Plan and confirming two board appointments/reappointments.
